section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Drive for Leanness Scale (DLS), including its item structure and scoring. It highlights previous research demonstrating the DLS's internal reliability and construct validity across three distinct samples: U.S. undergraduate men, Australian community men, and gay men in the U.S.
